alerts.title: Flood Watch issued August 13 at 1:18AM EDT until August 14 at 10:00AM EDT by NWS Indianapolis IN
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...Much of central Indiana.

* WHEN...Through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Flooding is ongoing. More rain is expected through tonight.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood You should monitor later forecasts and be prepared to take action
should Flash Flood Warnings be issued.

alerts.description: A form of credit card theft known as skimming is on the rise as thieves install their own card readers to steal your information and money. It's a particular threat to users of EBT cards. Carter Evans reports on how to spot them and protect yourself.

alerts.description: Two soldiers died after the military helicopter they were in crashed into a field in Texas, northwest of Austin. alerts.description: JPS Health Network patient access to MyChart has been down since at least Aug. 3, preventing patients from checking appointment schedules or refilling medication. JPS initially said it was experiencing an outage affecting several patient resources, including online services and phone lines, and was working to restore service ASAP. alerts.title: Man, woman killed in domestic shooting incident; relationship yet to be revealed
alerts.description: A man and a woman are dead after a fatal shooting that stemmed from a domestic disturbance in Denton on Sunday afternoon. Denton police said the shooting happened around 2:35 p.m. when authorities responded to the 1900 block of N. Bell Avenue after receiving reports of a shooting. First responders found a man and woman with apparent gunshot wounds when they arrived at the scene. Both were declared dead at the scene, officials said. Police said this appears to be an isolated incident with no threat to the public. Officials plan to release the victims’ identities and the relationship between them once their next-of-kin have been notified of their deaths. The shooting investigation is ongoing.

alerts.title: #StopRansomware: Gunra Ransomware
alerts.description: Advisory at a Glance Title #StopRansomware: Gunra Ransomware Original Publication August 10, 2026 Executive Summary Gunra is a ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) used by affiliates to target government, critical infrastructure, and other organizations. The Gunra ransomware variant first appeared in 2025 and expanded to RaaS operations in 2026. The actors leverage a double-extortion model, both encrypting data and threatening to publish exfiltrated data to a dedicated leak site (DLS) if the ransom is not paid. This advisory provides technical details of the activity, as well as tailored detection and mitigation guidance to protect at-risk organizations from Gunra. alerts.description: Executive summary People’s Republic of China (PRC) state-sponsored cyber threat actors are targeting networks globally, including, but not limited to, telecommunications, government, transportation, lodging, and military infrastructure networks.
